description: This file defines functions and constants for parsing and serializing path elements used in structured merge diff operations within Kubernetes, including handling of different path element types such as fields, values, indices, and keys.

methods.name: NewPathElement
methods.description: Parses a serialized string to create a PathElement object, handling different types such as field, value, index, and key.

methods.name: PathElementString
methods.description: Serializes a PathElement object into its string representation, encoding its type and contents.
